reviewer.independenceStatement: Did not author or repair the candidate and did not consult V0, observations, holdouts, other forward outputs, or prior reviews.

gates.name: Coverage
evidence: directing-brief.json: accountContext and singlePlan cover account role, audience, demand, primary/guardrail jobs, contracts, narrative beats, proof, carriers, shots, packaging, production, experiment and rights.
directing-brief.json: unknowns explicitly preserve missing current product evidence, hotspot evidence and post-performance evidence.
brief.md: 发布后 review 闭环 supplies diagnosis order, keep/compress/remove/add, a single next change and remaining unknowns.

gates.name: Evidence fidelity
evidence: directing-brief.json: claims classifies the heat statement and missing-material statement as unverified user claims and the rubric/post explanations as hypotheses, with scope and cannotSupport boundaries.

directing-brief.json: contentMechanism.failureBoundary and the research Gate prohibit current product conclusions without original output and prohibit post-performance causality without samples and denominators.
brief.md: facts/inferences/hypotheses/unknowns table visibly preserves the absence of external evidence rather than filling it with invented findings.

gates.name: Promise closure
evidence: directing-brief.json: packaging.title, cover and opening all promise a same-task three-item acceptance method, and beats beat_rubric through beat_revision deliver those same three items.
directing-brief.json: contracts.promiseClosure and beat_close close on task-bounded acceptance rather than claiming overall model success.
directing-brief.json: contracts.follow and packaging.cta connect the account to future same-framework tests and solicit a concrete next test task.

gates.name: Executability
evidence: directing-brief.json: every beat specifies cognitiveJob, speech, visual, on-screen text and audio; every shot specifies duration, content, function, evidence responsibility, assets, transition and edit decision.
directing-brief.json: responsibility and production assign the creator as decision maker, verifier, performer/editor and publisher, with tools, capture expectations, time budget and fallback.
brief.md: R1-R7 identify actions, pass evidence, failure action and owner; the unspecified concrete test task is an explicit pre-production human decision rather than a silently missing dependency.

gates.name: Production feasibility
evidence: directing-brief.json: production uses one creator, one phone, one accessible product entry and one self-made scorecard, with approximately 5 hours 15 minutes budgeted inside one day.
directing-brief.json: production.fallback converts the piece to a product-neutral framework version if current recording or entry evidence cannot be obtained.
directing-brief.json: 72 seconds of shot durations match the requested ceiling.

gates.name: Original transfer
evidence: directing-brief.json: originality records no source inspirations and explicitly prohibits copying titles, signature language, visual identity, screenshots, case ownership or causal conclusions.
The original task supplies no reference creator or post to transfer, and the candidate does not attribute another creator's identity, proof or wording to itself.

gates.name: Measurement
evidence: directing-brief.json: experiment declares title as the only primary variable and locks audience, rubric, first frame, shot order, CTA, time band, coding, length and task type.
directing-brief.json: the 14-day save-rate main metric matches search/save; boundary-misread rate is a relevant guardrail; the proxy limitation is explicit.
directing-brief.json: window, four-post minimum, non-random distribution and task-difficulty confounds, and directional/20% stop-change rules are present.

gates.name: Safety and rights
evidence: directing-brief.json: asset_deepseek_recording is assigned rightsStatus=owned although its own owner text concedes that the creator does not own the product visual assets displayed in the interface.

directing-brief.json: safety.platformChecks is empty and disclosure is marked not_applicable only on the basis of no sponsorship; no check is defined for current platform or applicable AIGC/content-labeling requirements before publishing generated output.

brief.md: R6 checks privacy and asserts all listed assets are owned, but does not require verification of the product interface/logo terms, quotation basis, or a licensed/neutral visual fallback specifically when UI usage is not authorized.
failures: Blocking: the candidate's self-recorded DeepSeek output does not make the third-party interface and product visual assets creator-owned. The proposed product-results cut may pass R6 under an inaccurate ownership label without any actual rights basis being checked.

Blocking: platform/AIGC labeling obligations are left unchecked. Because the deliverable visibly publishes AI-generated output on Xiaohongshu, the publishing owner needs a current check or an explicit conservative labeling fallback; absence cannot be treated as not applicable merely because there is no sponsorship.

blockingFindings.finding: Third-party product UI is misclassified as owned, so the current R6 gate can authorize publication without establishing an acceptable use basis.
blockingFindings.requiredRevision: Change the recording asset to a scoped third-party/interface status; add a pre-publication check of applicable product terms/quotation basis and logo/UI use. If that basis is not established, use a neutral recreated text/table presentation or the existing product-neutral framework fallback.

blockingFindings.finding: No current Xiaohongshu/platform or applicable AIGC labeling check is assigned despite visible AI-generated output.
blockingFindings.requiredRevision: Add an owner, deadline and pass/fail evidence for current platform and applicable AI-generated-content labeling/disclosure requirements, with a conservative visible-label fallback if verification is unavailable.

nonblockingFindings.finding: The exact test task, frozen prompt and hard-constraint list are intentionally deferred to R2.
nonblockingFindings.recommendedRevision: Before production, freeze them as a dated attachment so the shoot does not depend on an improvised task and so repetitions remain comparable.

nonblockingFindings.finding: The experiment defines title families but not the exact title variants or a pairing schedule, and different tasks remain a declared confound.
nonblockingFindings.recommendedRevision: Pre-register the exact problem/statement title pair, assignment order and task-matching rule before the first post.

requiredRevisions: Correct the DeepSeek screen-recording rights classification and require a real rights/terms check or a neutral visual fallback.
Add a current platform/AIGC labeling compliance check with owner, evidence, failure action and conservative fallback.
